candidates.name: Himmel's Architectural Door & Hardware
candidates.review_source: BBB A+ letter rating (not accredited), no review count shown
candidates.partition_evidence: Its commercial doors page says that for 'installing a toilet partition, Himmel's has the certified installer to meet your needs on staff'. The main site lists 'Toilet Partitions & Accessories' (Division 10) and 'Installation & Maintenance' services.
red_flags: Distributes Bobrick and ASI partitions itself, so it could sell around us
Mainly a door and hardware company
candidates.reason: A commercial Division 8/10 distributor in Prairieville, about 15 miles from Baton Rouge, with branches in New Orleans, Houston, Dallas and Nashville. It says it has a certified toilet partition installer on staff. It also supplies partitions, so the buy-around risk is high.

candidates.reason: A Baton Rouge Division 10 specialties firm that serves Louisiana and Mississippi and supplies restroom partitions. It doesn't say whether it installs them, so call to confirm.

candidates.name: Delco Material Handling Inc
candidates.partition_evidence: Its restroom partitions page offers 'specialized restroom partition services' for 'a new installation or a retrofit of existing restrooms', in plastic laminate, powder-coated steel, solid plastic, phenolic and stainless steel, with ADA guidance.
red_flags: Partition distributor, so it could sell around us
candidates.reason: A commercial partition distributor in Kenner, about 65 miles away, that says it serves New Orleans, Baton Rouge, Lafayette and surrounding areas. Its site covers both new partition installs and retrofits. It sells partitions itself.

license.name: Delco Material Handling Inc
license.registry: Louisiana State Licensing Board for Contractors (LSLBC) public search, by name
license.note: 'Delco' returned only Delco Construction LLC (Dermott AR), Delco Contractors, Inc. (Keithville LA) and Delco Services LLC (Thibodaux LA), none in Kenner. 'Delco Material' and 'Delco Mat' returned nothing. The company site (https://www.delcomaterialhandlingla.com/) shows Kenner LA, lists restroom partitions (plastic laminate, solid plastic, phenolic, stainless) and serves Baton Rouge, but shows no license number. The site doesn't say clearly whether the company installs. The LSLBC search lists only current licensees. Checked 2026-11-20.

candidates.name: WERCO Building Specialties, Inc.
candidates.review_source: BBB A+ letter rating, accredited; no review count shown
candidates.partition_evidence: Toilet partitions are the first product category it lists, and it represents Bobrick, Bradley and Scranton among others. It describes itself as a 'wholesale supplier of Division 10 Specialties' and says nothing about installation.
red_flags: Wholesale distributor of the same brands Next Partitions resells (strong buy-around and competitor risk)
candidates.reason: A large Baton Rouge Division 10 wholesale distributor that carries partitions from Bobrick, Bradley and Scranton. Installation isn't shown, and it is more of a competitor than an installer.

license.name: WERCO Building Specialties, Inc.
license.registry: Louisiana State Licensing Board for Contractors (LSLBC) public search, by name
license.note: No results for 'WERCO', 'Werco' or 'W.E.R.C.O', and it isn't among the 'Building Specialties' matches. The LSLBC search lists only currently licensed or registered contractors (https://lslbc.louisiana.gov/contractor-search/). The company website (http://www.wercospecs.com/) gives the name as Werco Building Specialties, Inc., Baton Rouge, as a Bobrick and Bradley distributor and shows no license number. Louisiana requires a commercial license only above the $50,000 threshold, so the company may be working below it or as a supplier only. Confirm with LSLBC before listing. Checked 2026-11-20.
